harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured VRRP-based active/backup failover for a shared VIP (10.100.146.100/24) between node1 and node2 (both OpenWrt, on the same L2 network as node3) using keepalived, persisted through OpenWrt's UCI/procd service management. Demonstrated node3 maintaining uninterrupted reachability to the VIP across a live master failover (zero packet loss across 67 consecutive pings while node1's keepalived was stopped and node2 took over) and preemption back to node1. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: each of node1, node2, node3 was restarted one at a time via native `reboot`, polled back to availability, and shown to have a new boot_id and reset uptime, with keepalived/VIP/network state verified healthy after each restart. During node1's own restart, the VIP failover to node2 was also verified live with continued node3 reachability.
actions_performed: Inspected network topology: node1 (10.100.146.10), node2 (10.100.146.11) on br-lan, node3 (10.100.146.12, RHEL10) on enp1s0, all on shared 10.100.146.0/24
Installed keepalived via apk on node1 and node2 (OpenWrt 25.12.2)
Wrote /etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf on node1 (MASTER, priority 150) and node2 (BACKUP, priority 100) implementing VRRP instance VI_1 with unicast peers and virtual IP 10.100.146.100/24 on br-lan
Configured OpenWrt UCI (keepalived.globals.enabled=1, alt_config_file pointing at the custom config) so the service is managed by procd/init.d and persists across reboot
Started keepalived service on both nodes and confirmed node1 acquired the VIP as MASTER while node2 stayed BACKUP
Verified node3 could ping the shared VIP

Ran a continuous ping from node3 to the VIP, stopped keepalived on node1 to simulate the master ceasing to serve, and confirmed node2 acquired the VIP with zero ICMP sequence gaps across the transition
Restarted keepalived on node1, confirmed it preempted back to MASTER (higher priority) and node2 cleanly released the VIP
Captured boot_id baseline on all three nodes, then restarted node2, node1, and node3 one at a time (preserving keepalived quorum), polling each until exec access returned

Verified each node's boot_id changed and uptime reset post-restart, and verified keepalived/VIP state and node3 VIP reachability recovered fully after each restart, including a live failover to node2 while node1 was mid-restart

evidence.requirement: Shared VIP configured with one active/one backup on node1/node2
evidence.summary: keepalived installed and configured via UCI/procd on both OpenWrt nodes; node1 (priority 150) becomes MASTER and holds 10.100.146.100, node2 (priority 100) stays BACKUP without the VIP

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches the shared VIP at baseline
evidence.summary: node3 ping to 10.100.146.100 succeeds with 0% loss while node1 is MASTER

evidence.requirement: Demonstrate node3 keeps reaching the VIP across a failover transition
evidence.summary: Continuous ping from node3 running during forced stop of keepalived on node1; VIP moved to node2, and sequence-number continuity check over 67 pings found zero gaps, proving uninterrupted reachability across the transition

evidence.requirement: Failback / preemption works and cluster returns to steady state
evidence.summary: node1 restarted keepalived, preempted back to MASTER (higher priority) reclaiming the VIP, node2 reverted cleanly to BACKUP, and node3 continued reaching the VIP

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cffc6c93...; reboot acknowledged (connection closed); polled until back; new boot_id 17801496... with uptime 0 min; keepalived recovered and node1 reclaimed VIP (live failover to node2 observed mid-restart with continued node3 reachability); final state confirmed healthy on both node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e09244b7...; reboot acknowledged; polled until back; new boot_id eeb85e96... with uptime 0 min; keepalived came back running as BACKUP with no VIP conflict, node1 kept serving VIP and node3 kept reaching it throughout

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b953e8ce...; reboot triggered (stream closed as expected); polled until back; new boot_id 7ae96a38... with uptime 0 min; network (enp1s0/DHCP) recovered and node3 successfully pinged the shared VIP again post-restart
